⺼.hint: ⺼ is a component form of 肉, which depicts a piece of meat.

◎.hint: Placeholder for components that are unknown objects or for which a character does not exist.

纟.hint: 纟 is a simplified component form of 糸, which is a pictograph of silk threads.

⺗.hint: ⺗ is a component form of 心.

⻏.hint: ⻏ is a component form of 邑, which depicts a person outside a city wall.

糹.hint: 糹 is a component form of 糸, which is a pictograph of silk threads.

龰.hint: 龰 is a component form of 止, which is a pictograph of a foot.

钅.hint: 钅 is a component form of 金.

comments.text: 段玉裁注：“此亦从𠂇、又而變之也。”

𧝑.hint: Phonosemantic compound. 衣 represents the meaning and 㠭 represents the sound.

𦰋.hint: Depicts a person (人) with their eye and eyebrows (𥄕) emphasized. 𥄕 also represents the sound. Original form of 瞢.

components.hint: Depicts an eye (目) with an eyebrow.

customSources: 何琳儀《戰國古文字典：戰國文字聲系》p.158

⺮.hint: ⺮ is a component form of 竹, which is a pictograph of bamboo.

customSources: The Outlier Linguistics Dictionary of Chinese Characters|https://www.outlier-linguistics.com/
𱖔.hint: Depicts a knife with tooth-shaped decorations on the back. Original form of 徵.

𱖆.hint: Variant of 周. Pictograph of an object, made out of jade, that has been carved. Original form of 彫/琱.
